$doc: Actions: whose items, Pending and Highlights (proposal 2026-10-06, design only, not built; waits for the owner's review). An item found in a note goes to the owner's lists only when its owner is one of that type's people (Settings → Actions → Whose items Distill handles); things others owe the owner go to Pending; everyone else's go to the note's Highlights. Pending and Highlights are drawn in a static sidebar copy (routing/sidebar-*.html) laid over the shared Sidebar, which stays unchanged.

states.label: B · To confirm after routing: only your items (and Aditya’s to-dos, which you handle); a quiet line says where the rest went; “for Aditya” on the row; an unclear owner asks
C · Pending: what others said they’d do for you, by person (or by date); Overdue in peach; a later note suggests Mark received
D · A pending promise: the quote and its line, Why; Nudge opens Add as Slack message to Aditya, prefilled; Mark received; Not waiting anymore
E · Highlights: one card per note or meeting, newest first, with its people, the wiki page’s key points and where its items went

F · A note’s Highlights: From the wiki page (its summary, key points and decisions, Open page), then Others’ actions by person, added to the wiki page in the next batch (Track as Pending, It’s mine), Your items; Open note, Copy as summary

boards.intro: Design only: nothing is built until you review it. Today every action item found in a note lands in your Actions lists, though most belong to other people. With this, an item goes to your lists only when its owner is someone you handle that type for; what others owe you goes to Pending; everyone else’s goes to the note’s Highlights.
